name: Lovable
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Lovable is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Lovable is a privately held AI software company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $400 million Series C round announced on August 12, 2026, valued the company at $13.3 billion.

Founded in 2023 and based in Stockholm, Lovable operates a platform on which users build software applications and websites by describing them to AI in plain language. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company.
round_notes: In June 2026, Lovable said it had passed $500 million in annualized revenue; that figure is the company's own.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Menlo Ventures led the Series C, with the Scaleup Europe Fund, managed by EQT, as co-lead and new investors including Tencent, Balderton Capital and Carmignac. CapitalG and Menlo Ventures' Anthology fund led the Series B, and Accel led the Series A. Other investors include Creandum, DST Global, Salesforce Ventures, HubSpot Ventures, Khosla Ventures and Nvidia's venture arm, NVentures.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Lovable appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Lovable's announcements of its Series C, Series B and Series A; reports by TechCrunch (June 2026 and July 2025) and Fortune (December 2025); and SEC Form D filings.
